newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grains quiet and little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grains quiet and little changed.

text.p: Trading on the UK physical grain market on Monday was quiet with prices little changed from Friday.
"It was quiet last Monday, but business picked-up on Tuesday, so there is hope," said a trader.

Traders said there was not much business going on at the moment owing to a lack of grain coming forward from the farms, and traders were concentrating more on moving the material than taking fresh positions.
"There is a lot of grain moving around the country at the moment and people are concentrating on the logistics," said a trader.
No business was reported on the fob market although there were sellers for Jan/Mar at 99 stg with bids at 98.50 stg and offers for Apr/Jun at 100.50 stg against 100 stg.
Delivered trade on paper looks good but traders said there was little tonnage behind it.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein in the Avon range and Hertfordshire fetched 115 stg Dec.
Feed wheat in East Anglia traded at 98 stg for Jan/Mar while 103.50 stg was paid in the south west for July next year.
Feed barley in East Anglia traded at 98 stg for Jan.
